note: 〱 U+3031 and 〲 U+3032 set by hand on a tuning page (one judge) that draws the mark with the construction that produced sources/glyphs/repeat-mark.svg and repeat-mark-voiced.svg: Klee One’s 〳 and 〵 joined at the elbow, 〲 with the dakuten of 〴.

judgeNotes.note: Forms scaled into one em were too small; the mark should be at least as large as GenZui Serif’s.
In vertical text GenZui Serif’s mark takes two cells and the one-cell forms took one; the vertical advance became 2,000.

references: GenZui Serif v0.113, https://github.com/mkpoli/GenZui/releases/tag/v0.113 (〱: 1,840 units tall, vertical advance 2,000)
